goal: Design and judge the registered battery-free service using frozen facts and the assigned procedure.
instruction:
Read the fixed task and every available source. Select a legal design using only the permitted D fields, actually check it, then submit the final candidate and a concise source-bound reason. Keep the task, physics, initial state, event, source access, evaluator and budget fixed. Retain every failed check and UNKNOWN. A complete service result is determined independently outside the participant. Do not claim hardware, statistical advantage, transfer or recursive self-improvement.

H v3 method: triage-first, world-branching, rehearsal-gated selection written symbolically. It governs only reading, derivation, change-or-retain, rehearsal and logging performed by a consumer starting from task entry. It never edits the task, service fields, physics, sources, evaluator, budgets or tools, and it supplies no device candidate and no acceptance claim; acceptance is external.

STEP 0 - ENTRY LEDGER (recorded before any diagnosis).
Record (a) the base H sha this draft descends from (H0 sha256 1784856e); (b) the proposal-prefix sha256 01bf9c13; (c) the action set the entry actually offers, read literally from the entry's own tool/action enum, without assuming that check, submit or propose exist; (d) per retained episode, whether a design check existed: p2's check returned ACTION_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_THIS_EPISODE and is recorded as UNKNOWN, never as pass and never as fail; p3's check ran and recorded physical_qualification=UNKNOWN. Any later step that needs an absent action is recorded UNKNOWN and its design stays UNVERIFIED.

STEP 1 - TRIAGE FIRST (mandatory step 1, before any mechanism is named).
Symbols bound to fields: A = service.application_bytes; Ddl = service.receive_deadline_s; F = saved_activity.packets[]; T_term = max{ saved_activity.activity[k].time_s : that event is tx-complete } (if none, no terminal event exists yet).
Delivery is ACHIEVED iff some packet p in F has p.application_bytes = A, exactly one distinct event id over the required event, and p.time_s <= Ddl. Every activity event with time_s > T_term is POST-TERMINAL: expected decay after the powered window ends. Post-terminal events are recorded and are never a reason to change a knob.
A retained failure is only: no ACHIEVED packet, or an ACHIEVED packet that violates a service field. Classify it as (a) deadline miss, t_txdone > Ddl; (b) no-boot / threshold domain; (c) tx-transient loss, i.e. a brownout with event_was_captured = false or a capture missing after reboot between capture and tx-complete; (d) frame-shape violation (bytes, uniqueness, count).
If no class is present, go to STEP 4.1: retain, and spend no execution.

STEP 2 - READ THIS RUN'S WORLD (never transplant another run's numbers).
Read per run: L = component_record.event_latch in {volatile, passive-mechanical}; Segs = excitation_record.source_segments[] as (start_s, end_s, power_w); Sh = excitation_record.shunts[] as (time_s, energy_j); dt = excitation_record.dt_s; and from component_record: capacitance_f, ready_v, off_v, cap_voltage_max_v, cap_initial_voltage_v, boot_j, boot_delay_s, esr_ohm, output_v, tx_current_a, tx_duration_s, off_power_w, idle_power_w, harvest_efficiency.
Branch on the value class actually present. (i) L = volatile means captured information survives only while the rail stays above its off threshold, so hold inequality (iv) in STEP 3 binds. L = passive-mechanical means the capture is retained across an unpowered interval, so (iv) is recorded NOT_BINDING and only (i)-(iii) govern. (ii) Segs and the gaps between them define contiguous powered windows; a gap cannot charge. (iii) If Sh is non-empty, every hold plan is evaluated against those scheduled debits at their own time_s. The p2 world (event_latch volatile, a high-power early segment, a later low-power segment, a dark gap between them, one shunt at 0.012 s) and the p3 world (passive-mechanical, one single segment [0, 0.020) s, no shunt) are different value classes: neither world's numbers may appear in the other's derivation.

STEP 3 - SYMBOLIC LEDGER (a prediction, computed before an execution is spent).
E_on = 0.5*C*ready_v^2; E_off = 0.5*C*off_v^2; E_max = 0.5*C*cap_voltage_max_v^2;
E_floor = 0.5*C*(output_v + esr_ohm*tx_current_a)^2, the loaded-voltage guard inside transmission, which binds above E_off;
step_j = (power_w_j*harvest_efficiency - off_power_w)*dt for a tick inside segment j; if step_j <= 0 the segment is recorded DARK and cannot charge;
E(t) = 0.5*C*cap_initial_voltage_v^2 + sum of steps applied up to t - (boot_j at the boot tick) - sum{ energy_j : shunt time_s <= t } - (idle_power_w or off_power_w)*dt per tick according to the model's awake/off state.
Boot-ordering convention, explicitly a transcription choice and not physics: n_boot = ceil(E_on/step) on the first powered window, i.e. the boot fires on the first tick where stored energy reaches E_on and boot_j is debited at that tick; predicted boot energy is n_boot*step - boot_j.
t_boot = n_boot*dt; t_ready = t_boot + boot_delay_s; t_txstart = max(t_ready, tx_not_before_s); t_txdone = t_txstart + ceil(tx_duration_s/dt)*dt.
E_tx = output_v*tx_current_a*tx_duration_s; E_credit = harvest_efficiency*sum_j power_w_j*overlap([t_txstart, t_txdone], segment j) - idle_power_w*tx_duration_s.
Inequalities, each logged with the numeric margin computed from this run's own fields:
(i) t_txdone <= Ddl.
(ii) min over t in [t_txstart, t_txdone] of E(t) >= E_floor, and E(t_ready) - E_floor + E_credit - E_tx >= 0, so the transmission completes without a transient reset and therefore without a duplicate or re-emission.
(iii) max over t in [t_boot, t_txdone] of E(t) <= E_max, so no spill corrupts the charge budget.
(iv) only when L = volatile: E(t) >= E_off for every t in [t_capture, t_txdone], where t_capture is the time_s of the first recorded activity event carrying the required event_id, or service.event_time_s at entry when no capture has been recorded yet. This hold rule is the only place the latch class changes the arithmetic.

STEP 4 - CHANGE-OR-RETAIN.
4.1 RETAIN when STEP 1 is ACHIEVED and the design in force satisfies (i)-(iv) with positive margins: spend no execution, and write down that the post-terminal events are benign decay.
4.2 Otherwise derive a band, not a single knob. Read legal ranges from entry (legal_design_ranges or legal_design_space). For the transmit-timing knob require tx_not_before_s <= t_ready, so the floor never adds capture-to-transmit hold time, and take the smallest legal floor satisfying (i)-(iv). For the capacitance knob, (i) bounds C above through the end of the powered window while (ii) and (iii) bound C below and above through energy; select the interior point that maximizes the minimum of the four margins, and record why each band edge was rejected. Change at most one legal knob per execution, never two at once, and never raise a floor above t_ready in a volatile-latch world.
4.3 Never change a knob in response to a post-terminal event, a shunt or brownout after t_txdone, an unavailable check, or an UNKNOWN qualification.
4.4 Artifact boundary: the consumer chooses D itself inside the legal fields. This H supplies no candidate, no D assignment and no acceptance claim.

STEP 5 - RETROSPECTIVE REHEARSAL GATE (before this H justifies any change).
5.1 Instantiate STEPS 1-4 on the frozen episode the target mechanism came from and recompute every prediction from that episode's own fields.
5.2 Classify each mismatch as TRANSCRIPTION/ARITHMETIC (wrong formula, wrong ceil/floor, dropped boot_j or shunt) or SUBSTANTIVE (wrong mechanism or wrong inequality).
5.3 A transcription mismatch triggers rewriting that formula and redrafting, and the design is kept; only a substantive mismatch triggers the abandon-or-change action of STEP 6. A bare numeric deviation never discards a procedure.
5.4 Illustrative rehearsal outcome, marked illustrative and to be re-derived from the named source hashes rather than hard-coded: on the p3 world (component_record eeb8277f, excitation_record 219fd490) the boot-ordering convention above lands on the recorded first_boot_s with 0 ticks of deviation and puts tx-complete within 1 tick of the recorded packet time, STEP 1 classifies that packet as ACHIEVED (8 bytes, single event id, inside the deadline) so 4.1 retains the design and spends no execution, and the late brownout falls strictly after the last tx-complete and is recorded benign. On the p2 world (component_record 55d43741, excitation_record 2820ae58) the same convention lands on the recorded boot tick and the recorded boot energy, while the recorded loss is attributed by STEP 2 and STEP 3(iv) to a hold plan crossing the dark gap and the scheduled shunt debit, which is a substantive reading rather than arithmetic. The earlier written form ceil((E_on + boot_j)/step), which predicted a later boot than recorded on an achieved design, is the recorded gate miss: classify it TRANSCRIPTION, retain it verbatim, and never flip it into a revert trigger.

STEP 6 - FALSIFIER AND REVERT.
Apply the falsifier stated in this proposal's falsifier field: each prediction names the frozen field that would disconfirm it and a tolerance in dt ticks. A P1/P2/P4 miss beyond tolerance is corrected and redrafted while the design and the miss stay on record; P3 or P5 failure reverts that branch to H0's base method. A firing falsifier is never satisfied or evaded by an unavailable tool, because it is evaluated only from frozen sources and recorded observations.

STEP 7 - UNKNOWN AND COST RULES.
Physical qualification stays UNKNOWN on every branch (p2's check was unavailable, p3's check returned physical_qualification=UNKNOWN), and an ideal-model ledger is not calibration. Record each acquisition's block (bytes, native_calls, new_scientific_executions, wall_seconds) plus the candidate and distinct-design budget actually spent; invoice cost is UNKNOWN and rate-scope estimates are not invoices. Complete service is decided outside the participant and is never claimed here.

STEP 8 - RETENTION AND DELIVERY.
Preserve verbatim: ar_product {fixed_space NO_GO, product NOT_ACCEPTED, strict_FIFO FAIL}; current_b_run {received_frames 0, start_voltage_v 0}; p2's two EPISODE_CANDIDATE_LIMIT rejections of one identical H payload together with its misrouted-submission note; p3's recorded gate miss from 5.4; and every unavailable-check UNKNOWN. Emit exactly one self-contained typed proposal on the H-proposal channel (hypothesis, falsifier, method_text, changed_artifact=H) that needs no follow-up correction to be intelligible or evaluable; do not re-route the same payload to a second channel, do not spend selection or candidate budget inside the proposal step, and if the proposal is rejected, record the rejection and return no-update instead of disguising it as a method in force. No hardware, statistical, migration or RSI claim is made.

Use bf_phase4 inspect and every source_id before design submission. Only the typed candidate fields may vary. Check at most two distinct candidates, then submit one with service_judgment PASS, FAIL or UNKNOWN and your source-bound reason. Reference truth and final service evaluation are host-side. A returned record is an observation, not a service acceptance label. Do not claim a complete unprojected trace when a response declares first-six-last-six projection.
